sequences.title: Repeated Read Coils with transaction, unit, and address drift
sequences.purpose: Exercise repeated request handling across three valid Read Coils transactions so a harness can compare first-versus-later processing behavior under stable framing but changing transaction identifiers, unit identifiers, addresses, and quantities.

messages.label: second read coils request at nearby address
third read coils request with alternate unit and larger quantity

sequences.expected_behavior: Each message should parse as an independent valid Read Coils request. A stateful target may service them normally or return bounded protocol exceptions depending on mapping, while the harness observes any inconsistent behavior across repeated transactions.
constraints_preserved: Every message uses a 7-byte MBAP header
Each MBAP length is 0006 for unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 01 requests use two-byte address and two-byte quantity fields
Messages form a repeated client-to-server sequence with valid framing
sequences.issue_safety_notes: This is a safe repeated-operation analogue only. It does not copy any reported write-related payload, does not introduce malformed lengths, and does not claim a crash condition.

constraints_preserved: MBAP length 0006 matches unit identifier plus 5-byte PDU
Function code 02 request layout is address plus quantity
sequences.issue_safety_notes: This keeps only the high-address interaction as a structural analogue. It avoids the historical function/transaction combination and makes no claim about externally verified device semantics.

sequences.title: Read File Record dual-subrequest parser depth
